title: Presentation Meta
description: Presentation basics. Store each requirement in its owning field without repeating the basics in constraints.

title.description: The presentation title, not a summary of its goals or requirements.

language.description: The presentation language, such as zh-CN. Do not repeat it in constraints.content.requirements.

count.description: Desired slide count, such as 10, 11-12 or 约10; may be empty when unresolved. This is a planning requirement, not the actual count derived from Outline. Do not repeat it in constraints.content.requirements.

audience.description: Who the presentation is for and their relevant background or knowledge.

goal.description: The intended audience outcome: what they should understand, decide or be able to do. Keep detailed content coverage in constraints.content.requirements.
